description: This file defines the Configuration class for AWS S3's 'UseArnRegion' feature, handling configuration options related to the use of ARN regions in AWS SDK for PHP.

classes.name: Configuration
classes.description: Class responsible for managing the 'use_arn_region' configuration setting within the AWS SDK for PHP for S3.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes 'useArnRegion' and validates it as a boolean.

methods.name: isUseArnRegion
methods.description: Returns whether the 'use_arn_region' setting is enabled.

methods.description: Exports the configuration as an associative array.
